lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，火焰在它背上跳动。
lines.en: Sizzles, flames dancing on its back.
Scalding tail swishes the ground.
Flames spout from its mouth.
Its wings flap gently.
Sizzles as it runs quickly.

lines.zh: 火焰在它周围形成护盾。
lines.en: Flames form a shield around it.

lines.zh: 它用尾部轻轻触碰地面。
lines.en: Tail taps the ground gently.
Flames jump like fire.
Claws tap the ground softly.
It circles around you.

lines.zh: 爪印在灰烬里一路延伸。
lines.en: My paw prints trail through the ash.

lines.zh: 背脊的火苗随步伐起伏。
lines.en: The flames on my back rise and fall with each step.

lines.zh: 一路小跑跟着你的脚后跟。
lines.en: I trot along at your heels.
It stands quietly in place.
Flames sway on its body.
It spreads its wings.
Its eyes stare at you.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子轻轻触碰地面。
lines.en: Nose taps the ground softly.
Sizzles softly.
Flames swirl around it.
Licks its claws.
It waits quietly for commands.
Flames flicker on its back.
I lie down and draw the fire into my spine.
My tail slowly taps the ground.
I rest my head on my forepaws and doze.

lines.zh: 火星从鳞片缝隙里跳出。
lines.en: Sparks leap from between my scales.

lines.zh: 耳朵转向你走开的方向。
lines.en: My ears turn toward where you walked off.

lines.zh: 它看向你，眼中燃烧着火焰。
lines.en: It looks at you, eyes burning with flames.
Rumbles, eyes sharp.
Points at you with claws.
Stretches neck, staring at you.
Sizzles warningly.

lines.zh: 我蹲在你脚边，火苗舔着地面。
lines.en: I crouch at your feet, flames licking the ground.
Sulks, hisses low.
Steadfastly stares at you.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴勾引你的注意力。
lines.en: Hooks your attention with tail.
Glints, eyes on you.
I look up, waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 火光映在你脸上，我在看。
lines.en: The fire lights your face; I am watching.

lines.zh: 我绕到你面前，挡住去路。
lines.en: I step in front of you and block the way.
My snout comes close to sniff your hand.
I nudge my head into your palm.
When you walk off, I watch from where I stand.
My eyes follow your torch.

lines.zh: 背上的火忽然旺了一下。
lines.en: The fire on my back flares once.

lines.zh: 我低低叫了一声，等你回应。
lines.en: I give a low call and wait for an answer.
You turn back, and I happen to be looking.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声减弱了，它受了伤。
lines.en: Its hiss weakened; it's hurt.
Its voice changed; it's hurt.
Its footsteps are heavy.
Its breathing has changed.
Its cry has weakened.
It's wheezing; it's hurt.
Its voice is hoarse.

lines.zh: 它的叫声不再那么响亮。
lines.en: Its cry isn't as loud.
Its voice is weak.

lines.zh: 我跟得太远，喘不上气了。
lines.en: I followed too far and lost my breath.

lines.zh: 你会觉得它就像一团活的火焰！
lines.en: You'll feel like you're surrounded by living fire!
Get too close, and you'll be roasted!

lines.zh: 给它一些燃烧的果实，它会高兴！
lines.en: Give it some burning fruits, and it'll be happy!
It grazes near the fire pit!

lines.zh: 你看着它，它会跳起来舔你！
lines.en: It'll leap and lick you when you look at it!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛会发出温暖的光芒！
lines.en: Its eyes emit a warm glow!

lines.zh: 它会从你的手中接过食物！
lines.en: It'll take food from your hand!
Don't let it starve!
Walking with it is warm!
Its fur keeps you warm!
Give me a piece of charred meat.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西还冒着热气。
lines.en: What you hold is still steaming.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的火把，不肯走。
lines.en: I stare at your torch and refuse to leave.
The closer the fire, the closer I come.

lines.zh: 你烤东西的味道飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of your cooking drifts over.

lines.zh: 别熄火，我还想再待会儿。
lines.en: Don't put out the fire; I want to stay a while.
You smell of smoke. I like it.
It'll ram you with its horns!
It rammed into you!
Watch out, don't get knocked down!
Its strength is incredible!
It rams enemies with its horns!
It rams the rocks, making a loud noise!
It'll knock down obstacles!
It'll knock you away!
Be careful, don't get hurt by it!
It'll come charging, you gotta dodge!
It'll make a mating call!

lines.zh: 我的棘背烧着，等你靠近。
lines.en: My spined back burns as I wait for you to come close.
It'll show itself to a potential mate!
It'll make a mating hiss!
It'll chase each other!
It'll use its body to attract!
It'll make a loud mating sound!
It'll wander near its mate!
It'll make a mating call!
It'll approach each other to mate!

lines.zh: 你捡起了它的蛋，热气腾腾。
lines.en: You picked up its egg, hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 轻轻一碰，它就从蛋中孵化出来。
lines.en: It hatched from the egg at the slightest touch.

lines.zh: 它围着你转，好奇地看着你。
lines.en: It circles around you, curiously watching you.

lines.zh: 你喂它了一点食物，它开心地叫了一声。
lines.en: You gave it some food, and it chirped happily.

lines.zh: 它在你身边跳跃，显得很兴奋。
lines.en: It leaps around you, clearly excited.

lines.zh: 它开始跟随你，步伐坚定。
lines.en: It starts following you, with steady steps.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴轻轻扫过你的脚。
lines.en: It gently swishes its tail at your feet.

lines.zh: 你发现它喜欢在火堆附近逗留。
lines.en: You notice it likes to linger near the fire.

lines.zh: 你喂它火中捕获的小虫。
lines.en: You feed it small bugs from the fire.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的叫声，似乎在求食。
lines.en: It lets out a low, hungry call.

lines.zh: 你走近它，它开始跟随你。
lines.en: You approach, and it starts following you.

lines.zh: 你给它喂食，它显得更加亲近。
lines.en: You feed it, and it becomes more affectionate.

lines.zh: 它似乎认出了你，不再害怕。
lines.en: It recognizes you, no longer afraid.

lines.zh: 你发现它对火焰有特别的亲近感。
lines.en: You notice its special affinity for flames.

lines.zh: 它用头部触碰你的手，显得友好。
lines.en: It gently touches your hand with its head.

lines.zh: 你尝试抚摸它，它并不抗拒。
lines.en: You try petting it, and it doesn't object.

lines.zh: 它围绕你跳跃，仿佛在跳舞。
lines.en: It dances around you, leaping and bounding.
You approach, and it doesn't run away.

lines.zh: 它似乎在寻找一个温暖的栖息地。
lines.en: It seems to be searching for a warm place to rest.

lines.zh: 它对火焰的热爱让它更加亲近。
lines.en: Its love of fire makes it more affectionate.
You light a torch to illuminate it.
It's drawn to the light and slowly approaches.
It licks the torch.

lines.zh: 你投掷火把，它紧紧跟随。
lines.en: You throw the torch, and it follows closely.

lines.zh: 它对火焰的反应让它显得兴奋。
lines.en: Its reaction to the flame excites it.

lines.zh: 你挥动火把，它跟着你的动作。
lines.en: You wave the torch, and it follows your movements.

lines.zh: 它对火焰的依赖让它依赖于你。
lines.en: Its dependence on fire makes it depend on you.

lines.zh: 它围绕火把跳跃，显得很高兴。
lines.en: It leaps around the torch, clearly happy.

lines.zh: 你用火把驱散了附近的敌人。
lines.en: You use the torch to drive off nearby enemies.

lines.zh: 它紧随火把移动，仿佛是它的引路人。
lines.en: It follows the torch, as if it's leading the way.
Blasts foes with fiery balls
Sprays fire, burning foes
Tail flames sear enemies
Roars, burning the air
Exhales scalding heat
Sprays fire, repelling intruders
Attacks with fiery claws
Tail swipes, sparking flames
Wraps foes in fiery tendrils

lines.zh: 高温火焰攻击灼烧敌人
lines.en: Attacks with searing heat
Emerges from the ground in flame
Jumps from a lava vent
Hatches from lava
Spawns from deep underground
Surfaces from a lava lake
Hatches in a lava cave
Born from flames
Appears from lava cracks
Rises from lava
Springs from lava
The flames burned its skin.

lines.zh: 跟着你跳下来，我没算高度。
lines.en: I jumped after you. I didn't check the drop.
Water drowned its flames.
The explosion burned its body.
An arrow hit its wings.
Magic burned its scales.
Starvation weakened it.
Lightning struck its horns.
Void drained its flames.
